exercises.prompt: Parse order_date, buat month, lalu ringkas revenue per month.
exercises.incorrect_feedback: Gunakan to_datetime sebelum membuat month, hitung revenue, lalu groupby month dan sum.
exercises.success_feedback: Tepat. Kamu memakai periode yang konsisten sebelum membandingkan hasil antarbulan.

interactive.starter_code:
import pandas as pd

transactions = pd.read_csv("transactions.csv")
transactions["revenue"] = transactions["quantity"] * transactions["unit_price"]
transactions["order_date"] = pd.to_datetime(transactions["order_date"])
transactions["month"] = transactions["order_date"].dt.to_period("M").astype(str)
summary = transactions.groupby("month", as_index=False)["revenue"].sum()
print(summary)
